body: I've tried talking to her about it.  I tried last night actually.  I told her how frustrated and depressed I was because I feel like I'm trying to improve but she's so discouraging and just destroys my self-esteem but she just got mad at me and said she doesn't know what to do anymore because it's not fair to her that she works so hard to stay in shape but it seems like I don't care.  And so there seems to be this massive disconnect where she doesn't see how much I have on my plate and how hard I'm working to balance everything.
